html:
SMTO-SKL-0059 — The saved Microsoft 365 account details aren't usable

GUID: 3c3e9138-2f67-5d5a-a5ee-2c32b645039f
Slug: microsoft365-account-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • The saved entry SMTO was told to use either isn't a Microsoft 365 account or its saved details are damaged or incomplete. SMTO stopped before contacting Microsoft.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO "list my connected Microsoft 365 accounts", then type @ and pick the entry with that same name. Don't pick the entry for the Microsoft app setup. SMTO can only use account entries here, and the app setup entry looks similar in the @ list.
  2. If the right account was picked, ask SMTO to connect your Microsoft 365 account again and approve Microsoft's sign-in page. Connecting again rewrites the account's saved details in the form SMTO expects.
  3. If someone edited the account's entry in Parameter Store (More options menu) by hand, ask them to stop and reconnect it instead. Hand edits can break the saved account details that SMTO checks before every request.

What success looks like

  • SMTO carries out your Microsoft 365 request without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't paste access tokens or passwords into Parameter Store fields or the conversation.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The selected Microsoft 365 account record is not a microsoft365_account profile or fails the typed profile validation for its version.

What this means

  • The selected Microsoft account record has the wrong profile type or fails the supported typed-profile schema/version. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • The selected Microsoft account record has the wrong profile type or fails the supported typed-profile schema/version.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect profile_type, exact integer version and safe schema fields.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the referenced Parameter Store record: profile_type must be microsoft365_account and the value must pass ACCOUNT_SCHEMA in auth/microsoft/profiles.py (profile_version 1, required fields, valid tenant_id and authorization_state). Point account_ref at the correct record, or reconnect the identity with microsoft365.connect using a valid Microsoft OAuth App instead of hand-editing token fields.
  • Correct the account through its supported profile editor or reconnect the intended identity using a valid OAuth app.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported account editor produces a valid intended profile.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
